Full Parameter Manifest for a D-Class Joint Bernoulli Model

Source: R/profile_joint_bernoulli.R
profile_bernoulli_terms.Rd

Enumerates every term the model will fit: the D covariate-dependent main effects, plus one global scalar per class-combination for every interaction order from 2 up to max_order (default: fully saturated, i.e. up to D). This is the thing that makes the model "automatic" in the number of antibiotic classes chosen – adding or removing a class changes D, which changes every count here without the caller hand-editing interaction terms.

Usage

profile_bernoulli_terms(D, class_names = NULL, max_order = D)

Arguments

D

Integer. Number of antibiotic classes.

class_names

Character vector of length D, optional. Used to label interaction terms (e.g. "Aminoglycosides:Carbapenems").

max_order

Integer, 2 <= max_order <= D. Cap the highest interaction order fit (e.g. max_order = 2 for pairwise-only – useful when D is large enough that the full 2^D state space or choose(D, D) terms become impractical). Default: fully saturated (= D).

Value

A data frame, one row per interaction term, columns order (1 = main effect), term (label), and classes (list-column of class-name vectors). Row count for orders 2..max_order is sum_{k=2}^{max_order} choose(D, k).
